2610.13267.title: Forgetting is Not Always Bad: A Neuro-Inspired Memory Repair Mechanism for Poisoned LLM Agents
2610.13267.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are highly vulnerable to memory-poisoning attacks. Existing defenses primarily rely on external modules for either static memory isolation or continuous online auditing, resulting in low memory efficiency and high computational overhead. To address these limitations, inspired by neuroscientific mechanisms that weak reactivation can destabilize memories and induce decay in the absence of reinforcement, we propose an agent-intrinsic training-free memory repair framework, DREAM (Dynamic Reactivation for Engram Attenuation in Memory), that enables selective functional forgetting of poisoned memories. Specifically, DREAM implements a three-stage pipeline: perturbation-induced implicit reactivation to reveal the structural fragility of malicious memories, adaptive anomaly diagnosis based on multi-dimensional activation patterns to detect topological anomalies, and a dynamic memory repair module that selectively suppresses harmful memories while reinforcing benign ones. Extensive experiments across diverse attackers and real-world tasks demonstrate that DREAM reduces attack success rates by over 95\% against backdoor poisoning while preserving strong benign utility. DREAM also achieves competitive robustness against injection attacks. In terms of runtime and token consumption, DREAM achieves up to a 2.13$\times$ speedup and a 37.7\% reduction in token consumption compared with A-MemGuard. Furthermore, DREAM also achieves a task success rate of 92.96\% on poisoned multi-agent systems.
2610.13267.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理對記憶中毒攻擊高度脆弱。現有的防禦主要依賴外部模組進行靜態記憶隔離或持續的在線審計，導致記憶效率低下和計算開銷高。為了應對這些限制，受到神經科學機制的啟發，弱再激活可以使記憶不穩定並在缺乏增強的情況下引起衰退，我們提出了一個代理內在的無訓練記憶修復框架DREAM（動態再激活以減弱記憶中的痕跡），使得選擇性功能性遺忘中毒記憶成為可能。具體而言，DREAM實現了一個三階段的管道：擾動引起的隱式再激活以揭示惡意記憶的結構脆弱性，基於多維激活模式的自適應異常診斷以檢測拓撲異常，以及一個動態記憶修復模組，選擇性地抑制有害記憶，同時增強良性記憶。針對不同攻擊者和現實任務的廣泛實驗表明，DREAM在對抗後門中毒時將攻擊成功率降低了超過95\%，同時保持強大的良性效用。DREAM在對抗注入攻擊方面也實現了競爭力的穩健性。在運行時間和標記消耗方面，DREAM相比於A-MemGuard實現了高達2.13$\times$的加速和37.7\%的標記消耗減少。此外，DREAM在中毒的多代理系統上也實現了92.96\%的任務成功率。
